archetype: Mono-Red Goblin Swarm, Infinite Untap Combos & Stack Protection

justifications.r1: A-tier mana velocity: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone, Springleaf Drum, Ruby Medallion, and explosive rituals (Skirk Prospector, Brightstone Ritual, Battle Hymn, Ashnod's Altar, Phyrexian Altar) deploy Krenko consistently on Turn 3 or 4 (average Turn 3.9 in goldfish simulations).
justifications.r2: A-tier card replenishment: Skullclamp draws 2 cards for 1 mana off disposable 1/1 tokens, supported by Throne of Eldraine (+4 red mana and repeatable 2-card draw), Rundvelt Hordemaster impulse draws on death, Conspicuous Snoop top-of-library play, Goblin Ringleader 4-card dig, Moria Marauder combat impulse, and War Room.
justifications.a1: A-tier selection and extreme functional redundancy: anchored by unconditional tutor Goblin Matron, library-stacking tutor Goblin Recruiter, Conspicuous Snoop, and Muxus, reinforced by a 9-source haste matrix, 5 sacrifice outlets, 5 untap engines, and 6 burn finishers.
justifications.a2: A-tier assembly velocity: achieves engine readiness by Turn 4. The 9-source haste matrix (The Fire Crystal, Goblin Chieftain, Goblin Warchief, Rising of the Day, Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots, Sting, Thousand-Year Elixir, Arena of Glory) eliminates summoning sickness downtime in over 80% of games, enabling immediate token doubling upon deployment.
justifications.p1: A-tier critical onset: presents a lethal board state by Turn 5 as Krenko taps for the second time, multiplying the Goblin swarm to 8-16+ bodies backed by Purphoros, Impact Tremors, Shared Animosity, Quest for the Goblin Lord, or Goblin War Strike.
justifications.p2: A-tier win compactness: closing the game requires only 1 opponent response cycle after onset (Turn 6 lethal finish). Non-combat direct burn (Purphoros, Impact Tremors, Goblin Bombardment, Goblin War Strike) and mass haste overruns bypass summoning sickness and combat blockers, with infinite untap loops (Umbral Mantle, Staff of Domination, Mana Echoes) ending the game immediately.
justifications.p3: B-tier exposure: highly visible, permanent-based creature and token swarm on the battlefield that clearly signals lethal combat and burn thresholds.
justifications.i1: B-tier reactive disruption: focused instant-speed stack protection and interaction featuring Deflecting Swat, Return the Favor, Untimely Malfunction, Chaos Warp, Vandalblast, Gempalm Incinerator, and Goblin Bombardment.
justifications.i2: B-tier proactive denial: Blood Moon completely shuts down nonbasic mana bases while granting unblockable Mountainwalk via Goblin King. Repeatable creature removal via Goblin Sharpshooter and Goblin Bombardment wipes opposing mana dorks and token armies.
justifications.s1: A-tier plan shielding: robust 8-card protection suite for a mono-red shell, including Commander's Plate (protection from White, Blue, Black, and Green), Deflecting Swat (free 0-mana redirect), Return the Favor (redirect/copy), Untimely Malfunction (redirect), Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots, Goblin Chirurgeon (free regeneration), and Eldrazi Monument (universal indestructible).
justifications.s2: A-tier engine recovery: Muxus, Goblin Grandee provides an instant 6-card board rebuild; Rundvelt Hordemaster triggers on board wipes to bank exiled playable cards; Goblin Recruiter restacks the library following mass removal; and Krenko recasts from the command zone with immediate haste.
justifications.s3: A-tier independence: the 99 functions autonomously as a lethal Goblin tribal swarm without Krenko, overwhelming opponents through tribal lords (Chieftain, Warchief, King, Trashmaster, Bandit Lord), Quest for the Goblin Lord, Shared Animosity, Banner of Kinship, Purphoros, and Impact Tremors.

overview: This deck is a high-power, synergistic Mono-Red Goblin swarm and combo engine commanded by Krenko, Mob Boss. The game plan focuses on deploying Krenko ahead of curve on Turn 3 or 4 with immediate haste using a dedicated 9-source haste matrix. Once on the board, Krenko exponentially doubles your Goblin count each turn cycle, rapidly generating lethal armies. The deck converts token volume into victory through direct non-combat damage triggers like Purphoros, Impact Tremors, and Goblin Bombardment, or via combat overruns with Shared Animosity and Quest for the Goblin Lord. It also houses compact infinite untap loops utilizing Umbral Mantle, Staff of Domination, and Mana Echoes paired with sacrifice altars (Phyrexian Altar, Ashnod's Altar, Skirk Prospector). The strategy is shielded against spot removal and counterspells through red stack redirects (Deflecting Swat, Return the Favor) and Commander's Plate, while Blood Moon punishes greedy multi-color mana bases.

core_strategy: Deploy cheap Goblins, mana rocks, or rituals during Turns 1 and 2 (Skirk Prospector, Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Warren Instigator).
Establish a haste enabler (Lightning Greaves, Rising of the Day, Swiftfoot Boots, Thousand-Year Elixir) on Turn 2 or 3.
Cast Krenko, Mob Boss on Turn 3 or 4 with immediate haste open, tapping immediately to double your Goblin count.
Deploy a multiplier or burn payoff (Purphoros, Impact Tremors, Shared Animosity, Mana Echoes) on Turn 4 or 5.
Close the game on Turn 5 or 6 through infinite untap loops, direct burn triggers, or an unblockable Mountainwalk combat overrun backed by Blood Moon.

keep: Hands with 2-3 Mountains, early ramp (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Skirk Prospector), at least one haste enabler, and a 1-2 drop Goblin.
Hands with Goblin Recruiter or Goblin Matron to tutor the missing combo or haste piece.
avoid: Hands with 4+ lands and no 1-2 CMC acceleration or haste enabler.
Hands overloaded with 4-5 CMC top-end cards (Siege-Gang Commander, Throne of Eldraine, Muxus) without early mana development.

key_tips: Always hold priority and equip Lightning Greaves or boots to Krenko immediately upon resolution to prevent targeted instant-speed removal before your first tap activation.
With Goblin Recruiter, stack Conspicuous Snoop on top, followed by Krenko, Skirk Prospector, and Goblin Chieftain to create an unstoppable top-deck combo line.
Use Goblin Chirurgeon to sacrifice a 1/1 Goblin token and regenerate Krenko or Goblin King in response to damage-based sweepers or destroy effects.
Blood Moon turns all opposing nonbasic lands into basic Mountains, making your entire army completely unblockable if Goblin King is on the battlefield.

critical: Exile-based board sweepers (Farewell, Sunfall) that bypass indestructible and regeneration.
Split second removal (Sudden Spoiling, Krosan Grip) that prevents sacrifice and redirect responses.
moderate: Heavy pillowfort effects and attack taxes (Ghostly Prison, Propaganda, Ensnaring Bridge) that stall combat lines and force reliance on direct burn or infinite loops.
Targeted instant-speed removal hitting Krenko before a haste enabler can be attached.
minor: Life loss from War Room or pain lands in long attrition games.
Opposing basic Mountains diluting the asymmetric lock advantage of Blood Moon.
